rule.hypothesis: intraday thesis renewal/invalidation improves robust pullback parents; confirmed reclaim adds entries
rule.pass: beats REF|BEST in EACH year; >=40 trades/year; >=3/4 halves not worse than REF|BEST; positive net minus Rs200/trade, positive without best day, drawdown <=1.25*REF|BEST each year; beats 20 null books median both years; no unresolved positions
rule.selection: choose best candidate by worst half-year net minus 200/trade on ONE year, ties name; must beat REF|BEST on OTHER year both ways. Reverse-year test is diagnostic, not chronological OOS
rule.honesty: all 8 reported; no second search or changed rule after results; additional Rs300/trade stress; seen-year passes are research candidates only, not real-money qualification

limitations: 2025 and 2026 have already been seen; cross-year selection is diagnostic
minute close/spread model, not live executable quotes; fixed 65-unit current lot
stress holds trades fixed; does not replay cash/entry changes from worse prices
cash12500_week_proxy filters multi-lot parent trades, not exact one-lot portfolio replay
2024 and forward sessions untouched; no Production changes
